messages:
Maya (CSM): heads up — KiteCrest went quiet after PoC wrap last Thursday. usage looks down ~85% compared to peak. anyone picked this up?
Jorge (AE): saw lower API calls in the dashboard. procurement mentioned a new ML lead started last week. name's Sam.
Riley (Solutions Eng): can we get a quick perf summary? I want to see latency/error spikes during the PoC handoff window.
Maya (CSM): quick query I ran: ```SELECT count(*) FROM api_calls WHERE account='kitecrest' AND timestamp >= '2025-11-01' GROUP BY day;``` shows almost flatline after 11/18.
billing-bot: invoice #KITE-2025-11 issued 2025-11-20 — status: pending. (no payment yet)
Jorge (AE): Sam told procurement they're running a side demo with NimbusAI next week. said integration felt faster in their internal tests.
Maya (CSM): ugh. any known regression on our side? was there a model switch or quantization change during final week?
Riley (Solutions Eng): we rolled a quantize-8 patch on 11/17 for lower cost. perf logs show median p95 latency steady, but a small tail at ~300ms for longer prompts. not huge.
Riley (Solutions Eng): attaching a short checklist for outreach: 1) quick sync with Sam to validate concerns 2) offer 1-week dedicated burst at no extra cost 3) share perf trace + KV-cache plan 4) propose a joint session with Eng + Solutions
Maya (CSM): drafting outreach msg. want to avoid sounding reactive.
Maya (CSM): @Sam (KiteCrest) — hi! quick note: saw drop in activity after PoC wrap. can we book 30m to review how it went and any blockers? possible slots Wed/Thu.
Sam (KiteCrest): Hey Maya — yeah, been heads-down. happy to sync Thu afternoon. main concern is cold-start for their long-doc folding use-case; saw 2x token cost estimates from Nimbus demo.
Nora (KiteCrest): also want to flag internal security review — asked for separate VPC diagram and KMS details.
Jorge (AE): ok good intel. let's prepare: pricing comparison vs Nimbus, VPC/KMS doc, and a rapid perf spike mitigation plan.
Maya (CSM): I'll own VPC/KMS doc + scheduling. Riley can do the perf mitigation steps. Jorge will lead pricing comp.
Riley (Solutions Eng): mitigation idea: enable prefix KV caching for their top 3 prompt templates, shave tail latency, and provide token-cost sim for typical 3-month volume. should cut apparent cost by ~20-30%.
Maya (CSM): proposed message to Sam: "we can run a 1-week dedicated burst with KV caching enabled and a cost projection comparing current usage vs Nimbus; no charge for the trial week — if you like results we'll discuss long-term commit." thumbs? :thumbsup:
Jorge (AE): +1. include clear success metrics: >50% reduction in cold-start latency and <=15% cost delta vs Nimbus.
Sam (KiteCrest): That sounds fair. if you can show the VPC/KMS docs first that's helpful for security.
Maya (CSM): will send docs today and block Thu 2pm.
billing-bot: note: flagged unpaid invoice to AE for follow-up.
Maya (CSM): action items: Maya -> send security/KMS docs + schedule call; Riley -> prep KV-cache config + perf run; Jorge -> draft cost comparison and champion slide. I'll update playbook with outcome after the call.
Riley (Solutions Eng): I'll also prepare a short demo script showing before/after token counts.
Maya (CSM): thanks team. keeping this as high priority — I'll ping again if we see further silence before Thu. :eyes:
